lines: *A man in a clean jacket approaches from the docking corridor. He's been watching you refuel for ten minutes.* Captain. I need transport to Haven's Rest. I'll pay {pay:the_informant} credits when we dock and stay out of your way the entire trip. I travel light.
Fair enough. {pay:the_informant} credits and you've got a ride.

I've acquired a collection of pre-colony artifacts, ceramics, metalwork, navigational instruments from the founding era. A buyer at Haven's Rest wants an independent appraisal before committing to purchase. I need you to transport the collection and oversee the appraisal. The fee is generous: {pay:the_forgery} credits.

Nothing dramatic, I promise. I'm just a traveler who'd rather not spend three days waiting for a scheduled transport. Your ship is here, I'm here, and {pay:the_informant} credits seems fair for the convenience.

Thank you. I can offer {pay:the_scholars_errand} credits upon arrival. The Collective values fair compensation for services rendered. Shall we depart? I should mention. I may have questions during the transit. Your lived experience constitutes a primary data source that peer-reviewed literature consistently underrepresents.

The Collective has authorized a research stipend of {pay:signal_from_the_deep} credits. And if this signal turns out to be what I think it is, your name goes on the discovery paper. You'd be part of history, Captain.
You'll be able to reclaim those once you pay the {fee:bill_of_landing} credit fee to acquire your bill of landing.
{pay:honor_among_thieves} credits and a favor from a pirate captain. I'm in.
{pay:honor_among_thieves} credits when you bring it back. And I'll owe you a favor, which, out here in the Reach, is worth more than credits. My crew doesn't forget who helps us.
{pay:the_forgery} credits for a delivery and an appraisal? That's good money.
